labels: ring positions: A2..A6 carbons, HA2..HA6 protons (N at position 1); keys as in the pyridine ring motif

carbon_proton.source: M. Hansen, H. J. Jakobsen, J. Magn. Reson. 10, 74 (1973), as tabulated (absolute values) in A. Bax, J. Magn. Reson. 52, 330 (1983), Table 1; 70 % v/v in acetone-d6/TMS (2:1)

bax_1983_measured.conditions: 50 % v/v in acetone-d6, semiselective 2D J spectroscopy

carbon_proton.signs: not given in Bax 1983 (absolute values); relative signs are in Hansen and Jakobsen 1973 (not read). Para-type 4J(A2,HA5) and 4J(A3,HA6) are negative in benzene (-1.3 Hz); both signs are tried.

proton_proton.source: S. Castellano, C. Sun, R. Kostelnik, J. Chem. Phys. 46, 327 (1967) (full text not read; values as used so far, consistent with |J(HA2,HA6)| = 0.15 Hz quoted by Bax 1983)
